rag.name: Subgroup.relindex_mul_index
rag.content:
@[to_additive relindex_mul_index]
theorem relindex_mul_index (h : H ≤ K) : H.relindex K * K.index = H.index :=
  ((mul_comm _ _).trans (Cardinal.toNat_mul _ _).symm).trans
    (congr_arg Cardinal.toNat (Equiv.cardinal_eq (quotientEquivProdOfLE h))).symm

rag.name: Subgroup.relindex_top_left
rag.content:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem relindex_top_left : (⊤ : Subgroup G).relindex H = 1 :=
  index_top

rag.name: Subgroup.relindex_dvd_index_of_normal
rag.content:
@[to_additive]
theorem relindex_dvd_index_of_normal [H.Normal] : H.relindex K ∣ H.index :=
  relindex_sup_right K H ▸ relindex_dvd_index_of_le le_sup_right

rag.name: Subgroup.relindex_mul_relindex
rag.content:
@[to_additive relindex_mul_relindex]
theorem relindex_mul_relindex (hHK : H ≤ K) (hKL : K ≤ L) :
    H.relindex K * K.relindex L = H.relindex L := by
  rw [← relindex_subgroupOf hKL]
  exact relindex_mul_index fun x hx => hHK hx

rag.name: Subgroup.relindex_dvd_index_of_le
rag.content:
@[to_additive]
theorem relindex_dvd_index_of_le (h : H ≤ K) : H.relindex K ∣ H.index :=
  dvd_of_mul_right_eq K.index (relindex_mul_index h)

rag.name: Subgroup.exists_pow_mem_of_relindex_ne_zero
rag.content:
@[to_additive]
lemma exists_pow_mem_of_relindex_ne_zero (h : H.relindex K ≠ 0) {a : G} (ha : a ∈ K) :
    ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ n ≤ H.relindex K ∧ a ^ n ∈ H ⊓ K := by
  rcases exists_pow_mem_of_index_ne_zero h ⟨a, ha⟩ with ⟨n, hlt, hle, he⟩
  refine ⟨n, hlt, hle, ?_⟩
  simpa [pow_mem ha, mem_subgroupOf] using he

rag.name: Subgroup.relindex_eq_one
rag.content:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) relindex_eq_one]
theorem relindex_eq_one : H.relindex K = 1 ↔ K ≤ H :=
  index_eq_one.trans subgroupOf_eq_top

variable {G α : Type*} [Group G] [MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableSpace α] {H K : Subgroup G} [MeasurableMul G]
informal_statement: If $H$ is a subgroup of a measurable set $K$ in a group $G$, and $\mu$ is a left-invariant measure on $G$, then the relative index $[K : H]$ times the measure of $H$ equals the measure of $K$: $$[K : H] \cdot \mu(H) = \mu(K).$$

id.content:
@[to_additive index_mul_addHaar_addSubgroup_eq_addHaar_addSubgroup]
lemma index_mul_haar_subgroup_eq_haar_subgroup [H.FiniteRelIndex K] (hHK : H ≤ K)
    (hH : MeasurableSet (H : Set G)) (hK : MeasurableSet (K : Set G)) (μ : Measure G)
    [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] : H.relindex K * μ H = μ K := by
  have := index_mul_haar_subgroup (H := H.subgroupOf K) (measurable_subtype_coe hH)
    (μ.comap Subtype.val)
  simp at this
  rw [MeasurableEmbedding.comap_apply, MeasurableEmbedding.comap_apply] at this
  simp at this
  unfold subgroupOf at this
  rwa [coe_comap, coe_subtype, Set.image_preimage_eq_of_subset (by simpa)] at this
  exact .subtype_coe hK
  exact .subtype_coe hK

C1_dependencies.name: MeasurableEmbedding.comap_apply
C1_dependencies.content:
theorem comap_apply (μ : Measure β) (s : Set α) : comap f μ s = μ (f '' s) :=
  calc
    comap f μ s = comap f μ (f ⁻¹' (f '' s)) := by rw [hf.injective.preimage_image]
    _ = (comap f μ).map f (f '' s) := (hf.map_apply _ _).symm
    _ = μ (f '' s) := by
      rw [hf.map_comap, restrict_apply' hf.measurableSet_range,
        inter_eq_self_of_subset_left (image_subset_range _ _)]

C1_dependencies.content:
/-- A set is a collection of elements of some type `α`.

Although `Set` is defined as `α → Prop`, this is an implementation detail which should not be
relied on. Instead, `setOf` and membership of a set (`∈`) should be used to convert between sets
and predicates.
-/
def Set (α : Type u) := α → Prop
